semantic_contract.leaf_scope: Only supported noncategory raw COUNT or exact projected DISTINCT with known finite integer output and known missingness, consumed exclusively by one frozen numeric model input. Ratios/category/recency/exact output or other-model consumers disable stopping.
semantic_contract.identities: Exact model/quantizer/scoring prefix, feature order and float32/NULL encoding, source/adapter/coverage, Q/C/anchor/window/action/grain/projection and consumer closure. No actual identities extracted in this source-only note.
semantic_contract.rows: Authorized complete source, [max(source_start,a-w),a); all global anchor peers excluded across partitions; apply action/grain/window before updates; NULL projected identities excluded only from DISTINCT; raw duplicates retained.
semantic_contract.bounds: After an examined subset, n≤true rawcount and d≤true DISTINCT. Certified unseen authorized eligible-row upper boundR implies ≤n+R / ≤d+R; R construction/index validation paid. Otherwise unknown upper bound cannot support lower-bin early exit.
semantic_contract.quantizer: Exact frozen comparator/equality and input encoding. Same-bin proof requires every admissible encoded value in one bin, including explicit missing state. No bound interpolation across NaN.
semantic_contract.saturation: For monotone finite-count encoding, encoded lower bound greater than all frozen finite borders implies top bin for remaining admissible counts. Retain certificate, not fabricated exact count. No numeric infinity substituted into model input.
semantic_contract.state_lifecycle: Anchor-local monotone accumulation only; reset/rebuild for next anchor. Cross-anchor expiry/corrections require separate exact support or widen/recompute; no clipped-counter decrement logic.
semantic_contract.outputs: Separate future terminal routing certificate/bin package; exact feature artifact contract remains exact. Native integration not implemented; no current feature matrices/model recipe substituted.

decision_if_negative: Keep exact calculation if no safe certificate, any consumer requires exact value, or complete paid cost does not improve. Do not modify current pipeline or add a gate.
